spans.s:
(इ) रवि r. 1st cl. (रम्बति)
To go, to move.

m. (-वः)
Sound in general, cry, noise, &c.
E.
रु to cry out, to sound, aff. अप्.

n. (-वः)
Sound, noise.
E.
रु to cry or sound, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Sounding, sonorous.
2 Hot, warm.
3 Unsteady, fickle or shaking.
4 Jesting, a jester.
m. (-णः)
A camel.
2 The Koïl or Indian cuckoo.
n. (-णं)
1 Bell-metal.
2 Sounding.
E.
रु to sound, Uṇādi aff. युच्.

m. (-णः)
The sovereign of Laṅkā or Ceylon, killed by RĀMACANDRA.
n. (-णं)
Noise, tumult.
E.
रु to cry (in the causal form), aff. ल्युट्, afflicting mankind.

m. (-थः)
The Koïl or Indian cuckoo.
E.
रु to cry or sound, Uṇādi aff. अथन्.

m. (-विः)
1 The sun.
2 The right canal for the passage of the vital air.
E.
रु to sound, passive form, to be praised or glorified, Uṇādi aff. इन्.

m. (-न्तः)
The sun-stone, a sort of crystal.
E.
रवि the sun, and कान्त in this compound, a mineral.

m. (-नः)
The monkey chief SUGRĪVA.
E.
रवि the sun, and नन्दन a son.

n. (-थः)
A lotus.
m. (-थः)
A flower, (Pentapetes phoenicea.)
E.
रवि the sun, and नाथ lord.

n. (-न्दं)
Lotus.
E.
रवि the sun, and दा to give, aff. खच्.

Copper.
2

The red lotus.
m. (-यः)
A plant, (Artocarpus lacucha.)
E.
रवि the sun, and प्रिय beloved.

n. (-लं)
The disk of the sun.
E.
रवि, and मण्डल circle.

m. (-र्गः)
The sun's path.
E.
रवि, and मार्ग road.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
Very high, stopping the course of the sun.
E.
रविमार्ग, and भङ्ग what breaks.

n. (-हं)
Copper.
E.
रवि the sun, and लोह iron.

m. (-रः)
Sunday.
E.
रवि, and वार a time.

n. (-कं)
Copper.
E.
रवि the sun, and संज्ञक^1 appellation.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320.

m. (-रिः)
The hero RĀMA.
E.
रावण RĀVAṆA, and अरि the foe.

m. (-णिः)
The eldest son of RĀVAṆA.
E.
रावण, and इञ् patronymic aff.
